decisions.reason: Preserve the unmodified upstream Apache-2.0 license with the selected reference originals; no change to local policy ownership.
Preserve the unmodified upstream MIT license and attribution alongside the alternative Apache-2.0 license.
C-CALLER-CONTROL matches the existing ownership boundary. Retain semantic value types and justify generic or trait-object interfaces by actual callers rather than importing all library design advice.

Existing rules cover applicable common traits, From/TryFrom, AsRef and validated Deserialize. Preserve required-only derives and domain validation; collection, formatting and reader/writer guidance remains conditional on concrete APIs.

The only selected upstream change replaces the obsolete Unique::get_mut example with Pin::get_mut in C-GETTER. This repairs a reference link without changing the recommendation. Retain existing getter and mutable-getter rules, local query and Option naming choices, and the previous conditional scope for iterator and feature names.

C-NEWTYPE and C-CUSTOM-TYPE align with semantic value types and valid optionality. Retain reuse of SDK types and actual invariant boundaries; do not require bitflags dependencies or builders without a consumer.
